doc.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023

title: Musical family and late arrival of jazz
summary: She grew up in a musical family, playing folk and classical music, and met jazz only at about 16-17 by coincidence.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Actually not so early. I got bit by music but jazz — I did not come in contact with jazz until I was 16. I grew up in a musical family. My grandfather was a conductor of an amateur orchestra. My mother was a music teacher. So I played folk music and I played classical music on recorder and piano and flute and all that. But jazz did not cross my path until I was, yeah, almost 17. And it was really a series of coincidences.
